name: context-menu-checkboxes
title: Context Menu checkboxes
description: Checkbox items on a right click, for showing and hiding layers.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItemIndicator, ContextMenuTrigger, } from '@/ui/context-menu/context-menu'; /** * Checkbox items on a right click, for showing and hiding a map's * layers, which the area reflects. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-context-menu-checkboxes', imports: [ ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItemIndicator, ContextMenuTrigger, NdIcon, ], template: `
Map {{ traffic() ? 'Traffic' : '' }} {{ transit() ? 'Transit' : '' }}
Traffic
Transit
`, }) export class ContextMenuCheckboxesExample { protected readonly traffic = signal(true); protected readonly transit = signal(false); }
